messages:
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stacked offer for Alex Romero (SRE) - base/bonus/equity check

Hey team,

Following the loop with hiring, Pete (hiring manager) and I came to a standard offer recommendation for Alex Romero (SRE IC3). Summary attached (offer_summary_montecito_sre.pdf) — asking for comp signoff so we can extend an offer by EOD Thursday. Key points:
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 12% (annual, cash)
- RSU: $90,000 4yr, 25% cliff; standard Redwood vests
- Total target comp (TTC): ~$186k first-year cash + RSU accrual

Questions for approvals team:
1) Are these numbers inside the SRE IC3 band and within recruiting authority?
2) Any objections from finance on the RSU sizing given headcount/cost center 22-ML infra?
3) Can we offer a 2-week signing bonus in case the candidate requests? Approx $7k one-time cap (will escalate if needed).

I attached comp-banding-reference-2028.xlsx for quick band lookup. If approved, Marissa — can you generate the formal offer letter and DocuSign envelope?

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Director, SRE Hiring (Interim)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stacked offer for Alex Romero (SRE) - base/bonus/equity check

Dylan — thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick read and a few clarifying notes:

- Compensation band: SRE IC3 band supports base $150k–$175k, target bonus 10–15%, RSU $70k–$110k typical. So your proposal is within band but a touch high on RSU for this cost center.
- Signing bonus: we can do up to $10k for standard approvals; anything above requires VP approval.
- Offer cadence: we prefer cash sign-on paid in two installments (30/90 days) to reduce churn risk; fine to do 2-week equivalent if preferred.

Action items for me: I can draft the offer letter and prepopulate DocuSign. I need final confirmation whether we want the signing bonus included and which cost center to charge for RSU (22-ML infra vs. 54-platform). Also: any relocation or remote stipend? Recruiting indicated candidate is remote in AZ and does not expect relocation.

If everyone is good I will send the DocuSign link and add the standard Redwood IP/confidentiality clauses.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stacked offer for Alex Romero (SRE) - base/bonus/equity check

Thanks for the clear summary. Finance side notes below:

- RSU sizing: $90k on 22-ML infra is acceptable but will push the quarterly equity burn higher than plan by ~0.04 FTE-equivalent for Q3. Marcus, confirm runway impact?
- Bonus: 12% target is fine; make sure payout is prorated for partial first year if start date mid-cycle.
- Signing bonus: approve up to $8k without escalations. If Dylan wants $10k flat, escalation to me is required with justification on competing offer risk.

Recommendation: approve the package as-is except cap signing bonus at $8k for auto-approval. If Dylan asks to go to $10k, provide competitor comp evidence and I will push to VP. Please confirm cost center; if we move RSU to 54-platform it eases infra spend.

Marcus — any objections on charging to 22 vs 54?

Karthik
VP, Finance Planning
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stacked offer for Alex Romero (SRE) - base/bonus/equity check

All — quick follow-up after headcount review this morning. We have flexibility in the RSU charge: 50/50 split between 22-ML infra and 54-platform is acceptable for this hire given cross-team ownership. That reduces the hit to infra and keeps the offer competitive.

Final signoff summary: base $165,000; 12% target bonus; RSU $90,000 (4yr) split 50/50 between 22-ML infra and 54-platform; signing bonus capped at $8,000 (approved). Recruiting to proceed and Marissa to prepare DocuSign with details and standard clauses.

Marissa — can you confirm you have the attachments you need and trigger DocuSign? Dylan — please let Pete know we have finance approval and ask him to hold candidate tight while we prepare the offer.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
